notice.title: Early days
notice.body: GTA VI is brand new and we're still mapping it. Some items are missing, and some lists may change as we check them, so you might need to tick a few things again. We'll post here when the guide is complete.

categories.label: Master of None
categories.intro: The 9 kinds of activity the Master of None trophy counts. Have a go at each one once. The game tracks them under Progress, Activities, and most come up on their own.

categories.label: Trophies
categories.intro: The full list of 55 trophies and achievements. Story and secret ones keep their names hidden here so nothing is spoiled.

categories.label: Story missions
categories.intro: Every main story mission, in chapter order. Names stay hidden until you've played them.

categories.label: Strangers & Freaks
categories.intro: Side missions from the strangers you meet around Leonida, one strand per stranger. Who they are stays hidden until you've played them.

categories.label: Tasks & robberies
categories.intro: The game's own 100% checklist: optional tasks, stick ups, vaults and fencing. Each row counts up to what 100% needs. Bank jobs, payday loans and Smash 'N' Grabs have their own lists.

categories.label: Exploration & activities
categories.intro: The rest of the game's own 100% checklist: each row counts up to what 100% needs, and the guide says how many there are in all. Card sets, meditation, playlists, video games, pool, mini golf and shooting ranges, race challenges and challenges have their own lists.

categories.label: Discovery
categories.intro: The game's own 100% checklist: vehicles, weapons and animals.

categories.label: Card sets
categories.intro: 18 trading card sets, 480 cards in all, spread across Leonida. 100% needs 15 complete sets. The Don't Touch My Deck trophy needs 3.

categories.label: Trading cards
categories.intro: All 480 trading cards, one row per card, grouped by set. A set counts towards 100% once every card in it is found; 100% needs 15 of the 18 sets, and the Don't Touch My Deck trophy needs 3.

categories.label: Meditation
categories.intro: 18 meditations at 10 spots: most spots have two. 100% needs 15 of the 18; the Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs every spot.

categories.label: Unique playlists
categories.intro: 2 unique playlists, unlocked by finding their posters.

categories.label: Video games
categories.intro: 4 video games to play through. Three are on the home console; one is an arcade machine. Finishing any one of them earns the Stick Fiddler trophy.

categories.label: Mini golf
categories.intro: 3 mini golf courses. 100% needs 2 of them.

categories.label: Shooting ranges
categories.intro: 12 courses at two ranges, 42 challenges in all, each with a gold medal to earn. Buy the $5 waiver pass from the range's clerk first. Tick a challenge once you have its gold.

categories.label: Pool opponents
categories.intro: 7 pool opponents at bars around Leonida. 100% needs 5 of them.

categories.label: Bank jobs
categories.intro: 22 banks to rob: 14 small banks (cash drawer and safe) open up in chapter 3, and 8 large banks with a vault open up in chapter 4. 100% needs every one fully done.

categories.label: Payday loans
categories.intro: 7 payday loan stores to rob, open from chapter 3. 100% needs all 7. Watch out for dye packs in the cash.

categories.label: Smash 'N' Grabs
categories.intro: 35 pawn shops and jewelry stores. Pawn shops open up in chapter 2, jewelry stores in chapter 3. 100% needs 34 of the 35.

categories.label: Race challenges
categories.intro: 13 race challenges, each with bronze, silver and gold. 100% needs gold in 10 of them.

categories.label: Challenges
categories.intro: 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, all open from the start. 100% needs 70; the One Last Thing trophy needs 50. The game tracks them under Progress, Challenges.

categories.label: Cocaine Flamingos
categories.intro: 125 Cocaine Flamingos hidden around Leonida; 100% needs 100. Only the ones with a black and white beak count: shoot one to break it open. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Magazines, books & comics
categories.intro: 27 magazines, books and comics. 100% needs 30 of these plus book swaps combined. Several are only there in early chapters. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Book swaps
categories.intro: 7 little book swap boxes. They count with magazines, books and comics towards 100%. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: WAiNK scans
categories.intro: Scan with the WAiNK app: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. 100% needs 100. Numbers follow the game's Progress menu. More are added as guides find them. The You WAiNKer! trophy needs 100.

categories.label: Stunt jumps
categories.intro: 128 of the game's 130 stunt jumps so far. They count towards the stunts line of 100% (300 of 397 stunts, with under the bridges, knife flights and base jumps). More are added as guides find them. Stunt jumps also count towards the Cunning Stunts trophy (250 stunts).

categories.label: Base jumps
categories.intro: 25 base jumps from towers, masts and cliffs. Land on the target within the par time. They count towards the stunts line of 100% with stunt jumps, knife flights and under the bridges.

categories.label: Knife flights
categories.intro: 40 knife flights: fly a plane on its side through the gap between two buildings. They count towards the stunts line of 100%.

categories.label: Under the bridges
categories.intro: 202 bridges to fly a plane under. They count towards the stunts line of 100%.

categories.label: Basketball hoops
categories.intro: 100 basketball hoops around Leonida; 100% needs a score at 90 different ones. The same hoop twice only counts once. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Unique races
categories.intro: 40 unique races in 6 groups. 100% needs 30 wins; the Earn Cash, Not Kudos trophy needs 20.

categories.label: Drone time trials
categories.intro: Top Fun drone time trials: 14 locations with 3 trials each, 42 in all, listed south to north. Beat the target time in each. The Top Fun trophy needs a win at every location.

categories.label: Gang operations
categories.intro: 39 illegal gang operations to clear. They open up through the story as you meet each gang. 100% needs all 39. Names stay hidden until you've done them. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Stick ups
categories.intro: Stores you can hold up: convenience stores and mini marts (including gas station shops), fast food and liquor stores. 100% needs 50 of the 91 the game counts; this list has every store on the map, so a few may not be robbable.

categories.label: Drug labs
categories.intro: 14 synthetic drug labs to destroy with fire or explosives, from chapter 3. They count as optional tasks. Names stay hidden until you've done them. More are added as guides find them.

categories.label: Animals
categories.intro: 255 animals in 8 groups to study with binoculars (aim, then hold R1/RB). Each dog and cat breed counts on its own. 100% needs any 100. Species get their own rows as they're found; groups not fully listed yet end with a counter for the rest.

categories.label: Vehicles
categories.intro: The game's Vehicles log, section by section, with each model's base stats. A vehicle is discovered once you've scanned it with WAiNK or been in it. Cars and service vehicles come in 15 classes; bikes, watercraft and aircraft are one list each. That's 277 models, and the game's 100% checklist needs 200 base models. Each section ends with a counter for the ones not listed yet. The Standout sets aren't here yet. The Whip It Good trophy needs 100.

categories.label: Standout vehicles
categories.intro: Unique vehicles parked at set spots around Leonida, plus two lists of cars you're asked to find. Each one is pinned on the map.

categories.label: Garages
categories.intro: 12 garages. 8 are for sale in the Vice City Real Estate app, which arrives in chapter 2: the Little Boxes trophy needs all 8, $160,000 in all. The other 4 come with the story. Each parking spot lets you register one more vehicle.

categories.label: Weapons
categories.intro: The game's Weapons log, tab by tab, with each gun's stats as the log shows them. The log has four tabs: Guns (53 slots), Melee (9), Explosives (4) and Variants (130). The game's 100% checklist needs 50 of the 66 standard issue weapons (guns, melee and explosives); variants are extra. Each tab ends with a counter for the ones not listed yet.

categories.label: Kenton's Treasures
categories.intro: Kenton's shipwrecks: 6 wrecks off Key Lento and the Keys. Wreck 1 has 10 doubloons, and the other five have 30 treasures between them. Kenton marks each wreck on your map; find the treasures with the metal detector and hand them to him. 100% counts his sets (5 of 7 on the checklist). He's away for a while after chapter 1 and is back by chapter 3, and everything stays open after the story.

pois.title: Vice City
pois.guide: Leonida's Miami-inspired city: beaches, nightlife and the heart of Jason and Lucia's story.

pois.title: Leonida Keys
pois.guide: An island chain off the south coast, joined by long coastal highways.

pois.title: Grassrivers
pois.guide: Everglades-style wetlands: airboats, wildlife and not much law.

pois.title: Port Gellhorn
pois.guide: A run-down port town on Leonida's Gulf side.

pois.title: Ambrosia
pois.guide: An inland industrial town built around its sugar refinery.

pois.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
pois.guide: Leonida's wooded high country in the north, for hiking, hunting and off-roading.

pois.title: Airboating
pois.guide: Race or cruise an airboat through the Grassrivers.

pois.title: Base jumping
pois.guide: Jump from Leonida's high points with a parachute.

pois.title: Billiards
pois.guide: Play pool in bars around Leonida.

pois.title: Gym
pois.guide: Work out at a gym.

pois.title: Jet skiing
pois.guide: Take a jet ski out on the water.

pois.title: Kayaking
pois.guide: Paddle Leonida's rivers and coast.

pois.title: Mini golf
pois.guide: Play a round of mini golf.

pois.title: Scuba diving
pois.guide: Dive offshore, including shipwrecks with treasure to find.

pois.title: Street and off-road racing
pois.guide: Enter street and off-road races.

pois.title: Zoo
pois.guide: Visit one of Leonida's zoos.

pois.title: Wyman's Classic Car Collection
pois.guide: Track down abandoned classic and project cars across Leonida for Wyman, a collector and local fixer, and restore them. Four of the cars are Ultimate Edition only.

pois.title: Fishing
pois.guide: Catch a fish.

pois.title: Hunting
pois.guide: Go hunting.

pois.title: Golf
pois.guide: Play a round of golf.

pois.title: Shooting ranges
pois.guide: Take on a shooting range challenge.

pois.title: Pool
pois.guide: Play a game of pool in one of the bars around Leonida.

pois.title: Basketball
pois.guide: Score a basketball hoop.

pois.title: Video games
pois.guide: Play a video game: on the TV at home or an arcade machine.

pois.title: Racing
pois.guide: Win a race: a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race.

pois.title: Stunts
pois.guide: Land a stunt: a stunt jump, a base jump, a knife flight or a flight under a bridge.

pois.title: Vice Got a Price!
pois.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game.
pois.revealedGuide: The Platinum: earn every other trophy. Nothing is lost for good, since free roam carries on after the story and everything on the 100% checklist stays open. There's no mission replay, though, so keep a save at the start and end of each chapter. Cheats switch off trophies and saving.

pois.title: Trophy 2
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 1 story mission Gone Fishing. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 3
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish chapter 1 of the story.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish chapter 1. It pops once you finish What's in the Bag?, the first mission of chapter 2. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 4
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish chapter 2 of the story.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish chapter 2. It pops once you finish Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of chapter 3. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 5
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish chapter 3 of the story.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish chapter 3. It pops once you finish Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of chapter 4. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 6
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish chapter 4 of the story.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish chapter 4. It pops after Starting From Zero, the last mission of chapter 4. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 7
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish the last mission of the story.
pois.revealedTitle: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the story's final mission. Story trophy, so it can't be missed. Free roam carries on afterwards.

pois.title: Trophy 8
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 9
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 10
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 11
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 12
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: Trophy 13
pois.guide: Story trophy: finish one particular story mission.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish the chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy, so it can't be missed.

pois.title: A Long Road
pois.guide: Reach 100% completion.
pois.revealedGuide: Reach 100% on the game's own 100% Completion checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, open after the story; what you did before counts). It's nowhere near everything: about 60% of the game. You need, for example, 200 of the 277 base model vehicles, 100 of the 255 animals, 70 of the 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions. Nothing on it is missable. The Path to 100% card in this app follows the same list.

pois.title: Cunning Stunts
pois.guide: Land 250 stunts.
pois.revealedGuide: Land any 250 stunts. Four kinds count and you can mix them: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, about 397 in all. Under the bridges are the quickest. Doing a stunt once is enough, and the extra challenges on its map icon don't matter. 100% needs 300, so this comes on the way.

pois.title: Master of None
pois.guide: Have a go at every type of activity at least once.
pois.revealedGuide: Have a go at each of the 9 kinds of activity the trophy counts: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race (a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. The game tracks them under Progress, Activities. Most come up on their own through the story.

pois.title: The Shootist
pois.guide: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge.
pois.revealedGuide: Get a gold medal in all 42 challenges across the 12 courses at the two shooting ranges. Buy the $5 waiver pass from the range clerk first.

pois.title: Top Fun
pois.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations.
pois.revealedGuide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Every location has 3 time trials, and one win there is enough for the trophy. 100% wants all 42.

pois.title: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
pois.guide: Win 20 different races.
pois.revealedGuide: Win 20 different unique races. There are 40 in 6 groups, and 100% needs 30, so this comes on the way.

pois.title: Baited My Tackle
pois.guide: Beat a rival angler in a fishing challenge.
pois.revealedGuide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Some time after the chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento: do that mission.

pois.title: Stick Fiddler
pois.guide: Play an arcade game through to the end.
pois.revealedGuide: Play any one of the 4 video games through to the end: every level once, the challenges don't matter. Three are on the TV at home and playable from chapter 1. The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade machines around Leonida.

pois.title: Trophy 22
pois.guide: Strangers trophy: finish one stranger's full mission strand.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish Andy's strand of 5 missions. Lucia only: Andy calls during chapter 3, then texts her address in Belville, where the strand starts. Still open after the story.

pois.title: Trophy 23
pois.guide: Strangers trophy: finish one stranger's full mission strand.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish Kenton's treasure diving strand: clear 7 shipwrecks for him, digging up the treasure with the metal detector and handing it in. He calls a while after the chapter 1 mission Island Dreams. He's away for a stretch after chapter 1 and texts Jason again in chapter 2 or 3, so nothing is missed. Still open after the story.

pois.title: Trophy 24
pois.guide: Strangers trophy: finish one stranger's full mission strand.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish Billy's strand of 5 missions at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. It opens after the chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and stays open after the story.

pois.title: Strangers & Freaks
pois.guide: Finish 8 strangers' mission strands around Leonida.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish 8 strangers' mission strands. Only some strands count: the side work of main contacts such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie doesn't. Confirmed so far are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; the rest are still being worked out. The game's own trophy list shows your count. Everything stays open after the story.

pois.title: Trophy 26
pois.guide: Strangers trophy: finish one stranger's full mission strand.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish Randy's Wish List: 16 sports cars to steal and deliver. It opens with the chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, which also gives you the Key Cloner. Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to see if he wants them; hotels at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds. Cars in better shape pay more. Still open after the story.

pois.title: Trophy 27
pois.guide: Strangers trophy: finish one stranger's full mission strand.
pois.revealedGuide: Finish Tyrone's strand. Jason only, from the chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy enough Kitty Litter labs for Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This. Still open after the story.

pois.title: Positive Mental Attitude
pois.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida.
pois.revealedGuide: Meditate at every meditation spot: 10 spots, 18 meditations if you do the doubles as both Jason and Lucia. Careful: the first one, with Lucia at Jason's house in chapter 1, can only be done then. Guides haven't confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so accept it when she offers. The last spot needs both characters together, after the chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

pois.title: Fair Game
pois.guide: Hunt down a unique animal for a stranger.
pois.revealedGuide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. Jason only: Bret texts after the chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and his first mission in Lummox County gives you his hunting rifle. Which animal pops it isn't confirmed yet, but it comes while working through his 15 target decks, which 100% needs anyway.

pois.title: Don't Touch My Deck
pois.guide: Complete 3 sets of collectible cards.
pois.revealedGuide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. 100% needs 15.

pois.title: You WAiNKer!
pois.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations.
pois.revealedGuide: Scan any 100 things with the WAiNK app. Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100.

pois.title: One Last Thing
pois.guide: Complete 50 Challenges.
pois.revealedGuide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (Progress, Challenges). 100% needs 70, so leave this till late and pick the easiest ones left.

pois.title: Hot Together
pois.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and get away.
pois.revealedGuide: With your partner along (possible from the chapter 2 mission Coffee Break), get a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. A fast motorbike helps, and the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia shakes off the helicopter. Large bank vault robberies give 4 stars every time, so it often comes on its own.

pois.title: Retail Therapy
pois.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level in between.
pois.revealedGuide: With your partner along, rob 3 shops back to back without losing your wanted level in between. Body armor and sticky bombs help. The 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well. It pops about half a minute after the third shop; if not, hit a fourth.

pois.title: Whip It Good
pois.guide: Discover 100 vehicles.
pois.revealedGuide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning one with the WAiNK app is enough, so stand by a busy road and scan whatever passes. 100% needs 200 base models, so this comes on the way. Progress, Vehicles in the game shows your totals.

pois.title: Gunslinger
pois.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus.
pois.revealedGuide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus, which slows time while you aim. Top up your focus first with food, drink or a shower, and Adrenaline makes it last longer. Gang operation guards work; soldiers, police and civilians don't seem to. An assault rifle and body armor help, and it gets easier as your focus levels up.

pois.title: Trophy 37
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (the one at E3/E4 is easiest), back it out to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport. Jets parked out on the airfield don't count.

pois.title: Trophy 38
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west of Mariana County (the tanks are on the south side of the base), then shoot some enemies from it.

pois.title: Sneakthief
pois.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted.
pois.revealedGuide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. The chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun: use it on a store's back door, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm in the back room. It pops once you've left. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good one.

pois.title: Maximum Withdrawal
pois.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away each time.
pois.revealedGuide: Rob the vault at 5 of the 8 large banks and get away each time. Vaults open with the chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. After that, buy security van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) and follow the van to its bank. Bring your partner to carry the second bag. You get 4 stars at once, so have a fast bike ready. 100% needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.

pois.title: A Classic Blitz Play
pois.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away.
pois.revealedGuide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. A large bank vault robbery counts, so it comes with the chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. To get it sooner, block an armored truck near a Vice City bank and sticky-bomb its back doors.

pois.title: The Goodtime State
pois.guide: Explore the whole of Leonida.
pois.revealedGuide: Clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is the quickest way.

pois.title: Pest Control
pois.guide: Rob an illegal operation run by each gang.
pois.revealedGuide: Rob at least one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations, and 100% needs all of them. Progress, Gangs in the game shows how many of each gang's you've done.

pois.title: Trophy 44
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing by the bar.

pois.title: Trophy 45
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it out through the window. You need the Key Cloner from the chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, and only that car works. It pops once you've driven off down the street.

pois.title: Trophy 46
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office off the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs). It pops once you lose the police. You can come back for any you missed once the robbery resets.

pois.title: Trophy 47
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Max out Strength on Jason and Lucia. Work out together at a fitness club (possible from the chapter 2 mission Coffee Break): while one of you trains, the other does too.

pois.title: Trophy 48
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Rack up 500 actions on your criminal profile. Nearly everything counts, from quiet robberies and clean escapes to wounding or killing, so it comes on its own. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the game's UI settings to watch it; the in-game trophy list shows the count.

pois.title: Trophy 49
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Not worked out yet. Guides think it's tied to the payday loan store from the prologue, in Little Cuba, robbed again in some particular way.

pois.title: Trophy 50
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: Find the UFO. On the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, alone and after 2 AM, look for a car with flashing lights at the roadside. Follow the path into the woods, help the woman the UFO drops, and take her back to her car. It doesn't happen every time: drive off and come back.

pois.title: Trophy 51
pois.guide: Secret trophy. The game keeps this one hidden until you earn it.
pois.revealedGuide: On a bike, kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds. Busy spots like Ocean Beach are best.

pois.title: Dime on the Dollar
pois.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts.
pois.revealedGuide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences, over as many trips as you like. The Dye Pack Jammer comes with the chapter 3 mission Credit Check. Then rob banks and payday loans and take the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani pays the most.

pois.title: Treat Yo Self
pois.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops.
pois.revealedGuide: Spend $100,000 in total at shops of any kind. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most.

pois.title: Little Boxes
pois.guide: Buy every garage property.
pois.revealedGuide: Buy all 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate app, $160,000 in all. The app arrives soon after the chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 garages the story gives you don't count.

pois.title: On the Spot
pois.guide: Register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app.
pois.revealedGuide: Register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app, which arrives with the chapter 2 mission Moses. Each one needs a free garage parking spot (see Little Boxes). Take a car to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn, respray it and register it. From chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray too. Cheap cars keep the cost down.

pois.title: Story mission 1
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia sits down with a prison counselor about her arrest and her chance of getting out early.

pois.title: Story mission 2
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: A smuggling run falls apart and Jason has to get Donnie away from the Kingfishers in Pelican Valley. Back home in the Keys, Lucia phones with news of her early release.

pois.title: Story mission 3
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason goes to Ammu-Nation for a long gun.

pois.title: Story mission 4
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason takes his Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care to get it fixed up.

pois.title: Story mission 5
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Collecting rent for Brian at a gift shop that fronts for an acid lab, Jason leaves with product when there's no cash.

pois.title: Story mission 6
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason and Cal go to Hamlet after money Brian is owed. It's in the trunk of a car in the police impound, so Jason takes the car, resprays it and delivers it to Brian's storage.

pois.title: Story mission 7
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Collecting rent from Mandy, one of Brian's tenants, Jason ends up doing some repairs around her place.

pois.title: Story mission 8
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: After the trouble with the Kingfishers, Brian's broker Arnold stops answering. Jason and Cal track him down and it turns into a confrontation.

pois.title: Story mission 9
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason takes a bachelor party diving on a wreck as cover for Kenton's treasure hunt. The dive goes wrong, but he finds treasure and agrees to work with Kenton.

pois.title: Story mission 10
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason and Cal move the furniture around to get the house ready for Lucia, on what may be Jason's last night single.

pois.title: Story mission 11
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia is released and Jason takes her to the Rusty Anchor to celebrate. Her old cellmate Kat turns up with her wealthy boyfriend Mattia, and a fight cuts the night short.

pois.title: Story mission 12
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason and Lucia try to open a joint bank account, get turned down, and settle for the BuckMe app.

pois.title: Story mission 13
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason goes into the Grassrivers for a package Donnie dropped while drunk.

pois.title: Story mission 14
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason takes Lucia along on a smuggling flight in Brian's seaplane and they run into trouble with Brian's new suppliers. Lucia has missed calls from her P.O., and they only just make it home in time.

pois.title: Story mission 15
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: After guiding a smuggling plane in under the radar, Donnie talks Jason into a detour to sell stolen product to a biker gang. It goes badly, and Jason gets them out alive.

pois.title: Story mission 16
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Mattia has Lucia's ankle tag taken off and takes the pair out on a yacht and to a club in Vice City. The next morning he offers them a well-paid job fetching a bag from a locker, and Jason isn't convinced.

pois.title: Story mission 17
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason goes with Brian and Lori to settle Donnie's trouble with the Kingfishers, and it's a setup. Jason finds Donnie dead, Lori is taken, and a chase across the Grassrivers gets her back. Brian says he's done with smuggling.

pois.title: Story mission 18
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Brian asks Jason to go to Donnie's trailer and make it look as though he left town.

pois.title: Story mission 19
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Cal is taking Donnie's death hard, so Jason and Lucia take him fishing and say their goodbyes.

pois.title: Story mission 20
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: The locker job is on. Jason and Lucia collect the bag in disguise and are arrested, then dirty cops attack and Jason is badly hurt. They get away with the bag and Cal drives Jason to hospital.

pois.title: Story mission 21
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: With Jason heading to hospital, Lucia goes home for his stash and is attacked by masked men after the bag. She gets away, and the house burns down.

pois.title: Story mission 22
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 1.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia reaches Jason at the hospital in Vice City, where the dirty cops and the masked men are waiting. They fight their way out and run west to Kelly County.

pois.title: Story mission 23
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason comes round in a Port Gellhorn motel. The dirty cop from the Visitor Center is on the news blaming them, and the bag turns out to hold an old statue and a hard drive.

pois.title: Story mission 24
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia goes to dump the ambulance she escaped in and walks in on a gang trying to steal it.

pois.title: Story mission 25
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: With Jason laid up, Lucia fetches supplies from a gas station near the motel.

pois.title: Story mission 26
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Jason needs painkillers. Lucia meets Vicki, a dancer who shows her around Port Gellhorn and introduces her to Dunk, a local dealer who says he can help.

pois.title: Story mission 27
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Lucia meets the mechanic Moses Watkins, who hands her a slim jim and offers to fence any untracked cars she brings him.

pois.title: Story mission 28
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Moses wants a particular Canis Crawler and pays Lucia to steal it.

pois.title: Story mission 29
pois.guide: A main story mission in chapter 2.
pois.revealedGuide: Dunk and Lucia kidnap a crooked local doctor to get Jason proper painkillers. His meeting with the Kolts turns into a fight and the doctor is killed, but Jason gets his pills and Dunk becomes a contact for selling narcotics.

pois.title: Albino American Alligator

pois.title: American Alligator
pois.guide: Big swamp predator that hides well; keep your distance.

pois.title: American Crocodile
pois.guide: Leonida's biggest reptile, at home in salt water along the coast.

pois.title: American Red Fox
pois.guide: Bigger than a gray fox, with a white tail tip. Lives in the northern forests.

pois.title: Black Fox
pois.guide: Rare black-furred fox, seen in several parts of Leonida. A light rifle keeps the pelt clean.

pois.title: Box Turtle
pois.guide: Small turtle that shuts itself inside its shell; easiest to find in the swamps.

pois.title: Canada Goose
pois.guide: Black head, white cheeks. Common on fresh water and in town parks, and it will charge you.

pois.title: Cane Toad
pois.guide: Huge toad that lives mostly in the swamps. A heavy gun spoils the pelt.

pois.title: Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake
pois.guide: Listen for the rattle in the forests. Its bite can kill, so take care.

pois.title: Eastern Gray Squirrel
pois.guide: Common everywhere, usually busy with nuts and seeds. An easy shot with a light rifle.

pois.title: Golden Fox
pois.guide: Rare golden-furred red fox from the northern forests. Go gentle to keep the pelt.

pois.title: Green Iguana
pois.guide: Invasive lizard all over the warm south, towns included, usually near water.

pois.title: Leonida Cottonmouth
pois.guide: Venomous swamp snake with dark bands around a thick body.

pois.title: Leonida Kingsnake
pois.guide: Mid-sized brown constrictor with yellow bands, in forests and grassland. A heavy gun ruins it.

pois.title: Leonida Wild Turkey
pois.guide: Big turkey of the forests and grassy lowlands. Go gentle to keep the carcass.

pois.title: Leonida Wild White Tom
pois.guide: Rare white-feathered wild turkey, in forests and grassy lowlands.

pois.title: Marsh Rabbit
pois.guide: Shy little rabbit of the swamps and southern coast; a light rifle does it.

pois.title: Mottled Duck
pois.guide: Freshwater duck with a glossy blue patch on each wing.

pois.title: North American River Otter
pois.guide: Dark brown otter of the swamps, sometimes along rivers.

pois.title: Northern Black Coyote
pois.guide: Rare black-furred coyote of the forests and swamps. Keep your distance.

pois.title: Northern Coyote
pois.guide: Red-gray coyote with big ears that hunts in packs through forests and swamps. Best taken at long range.

pois.title: Northern Raccoon
pois.guide: Out at night, raiding bins in town as happily as it lives in forests and swamps.

pois.title: Nutria
pois.guide: Invasive water rodent that looks like an oversized rat, found in the swamps. A heavy gun ruins it.

pois.title: Round-Tailed Muskrat
pois.guide: Small water rodent with a compact body and a long scaly tail, near swamps and fresh water.

pois.title: Softshell Turtle
pois.guide: Swamp turtle with a long snorkel nose; a light rifle is enough.

pois.title: Spectacled Caiman
pois.guide: Smaller cousin of the alligator, just as tough.

pois.title: Whitetail Deer
pois.guide: Grazes in woods, swamps and grassy lowlands. Spooks easily, so shoot from far off.

pois.title: Wild Boar
pois.guide: Aggressive forager of woods and swamps, out mostly at night.

pois.title: Atlantic Spadefish

pois.title: Cobia
pois.guide: Brown-banded fish of the deep sea around Leonida.

pois.title: Great Barracuda

pois.title: Green Moray Eel

pois.title: Hogfish

pois.guide: Tall flat face with blue stripes. In coastal water to the south and west.

pois.title: Mahi-Mahi

pois.title: Northern Red Snapper
pois.guide: Bright red, thick-bodied fish, most common in the warmer south.

pois.title: Red Lionfish

pois.title: Spotted Moray Eel
pois.guide: Spotted eel hiding in the coastal reefs.

pois.title: Stoplight Parrotfish

pois.title: Tiger Grouper

pois.title: Yellowtail Snapper
pois.guide: Yellow forked tail; southern coast and deeper western water.

pois.title: Bottlenose Dolphin
pois.guide: Common in the sea all around Leonida; long snout.

pois.title: Green Sea Turtle
